022import java.util.List;
023
024public abstract class ZonePracticeApi
025{
026
027    /**
028     * Incremented on every additive API release. 2.4.0 = 3, 2.5.0 = 4, 2.6.0 = 5, 2.7.0 = 6, 2.8.0 = 7,
029     * 2.9.0 = 8, 2.10.0 = 9, 2.11.0 = 10.
030     */
031    public static final int API_VERSION = 10;
032
033    /**
034     * Use {@link #getInstance()}. Kept for binary compatibility; set by the core plugin only.
035     */
036    @Deprecated
037    public static ZonePracticeApi instance = null;
038
039    public static ZonePracticeApi getInstance() {
040        return instance;
041    }
042
043    /**
044     * Check whether ZonePractice Pro has registered its API implementation.
045     * @return true if {@link #getInstance()} returns a non-null instance
046     */
047    public static boolean isAvailable() {
048        return instance != null;
049    }
050
051    /**
052     * Get the player's division. Main thread only.
053     * @param player The player
054     * @param divisionName Short or Full name of the division
055     * @return The player's division, or null if the player has no loaded profile
056     */
057    public abstract String getPlayerDivision(Player player, DivisionName divisionName);
058
059    /**
060     * Get the amount of unranked matches left for the player. Main thread only.
061     * @param player The player
062     * @return The amount of unranked matches left, or -1 if the player has no loaded profile
063     */
064    public abstract int getPlayerUnRankedLeft(Player player);
065
066    /**
067     * Get the amount of ranked matches left for the player. Main thread only.
068     * @param player The player
069     * @return The amount of ranked matches left, or -1 if the player has no loaded profile
070     */
071    public abstract int getPlayerRankedLeft(Player player);
072
073    /**
074     * Reset the player's unranked matches. Does nothing if the player has no loaded profile.
075     * Main thread only.
076     * @param player The player
077     */
078    public abstract void resetPlayerUnRanked(Player player);
079
080    /**
081     * Reset the player's ranked matches. Does nothing if the player has no loaded profile.
082     * Main thread only.
083     * @param player The player
084     */
085    public abstract void resetPlayerRanked(Player player);
086
087    /**
088     * Add unranked matches to the player. Does nothing if the player has no loaded profile.
089     * Main thread only.
090     * @param player The player
091     * @param amount The amount of unranked matches to add
092     */
093    public abstract void addPlayerUnRanked(Player player, int amount);
094
095    /**
096     * Add ranked matches to the player. Does nothing if the player has no loaded profile.
097     * Main thread only.
098     * @param player The player
099     * @param amount The amount of ranked matches to add
100     */
101    public abstract void addPlayerRanked(Player player, int amount);
102
103    /**
104     * End the match for the player. Does nothing if the player is not in a match.
105     * Main thread only.
106     * @param player The player
107     * @param endMessage The message to send to the match, in MiniMessage format. Nullable.
108     */
109    public abstract void endMatch(Player player, String endMessage);
110
111    /**
112     * Get the player's elo for a specific ladder. Main thread only.
113     * @param player The player
114     * @param ladder The ladder
115     * @return The player's elo, or -1 if the player has no loaded profile, the ladder name is unknown,
116     *         or the ladder is unranked-only
117     */
118    public abstract int getElo(Player player, String ladder);
119
120    /**
121     * Get the player's experience points. Main thread only.
122     * @param player The player
123     * @return The player's experience, or -1 if the player has no loaded profile
124     */
125    public abstract int getExperience(Player player);
126
127    /**
128     * Get the player's wins for a specific weight class. Main thread only.
129     * @param player The player
130     * @param ladder The ladder
131     * @param weightClass The weight class
132     * @return The player's wins, or -1 if the player has no loaded profile or the ladder name is unknown
133     */
134    public abstract int getLadderWins(Player player, String ladder, WeightClass weightClass);
135
136    /**
137     * Get the player's losses for a specific weight class. Main thread only.
138     * @param player The player
139     * @param ladder The ladder
140     * @param weightClass The weight class
141     * @return The player's losses, or -1 if the player has no loaded profile or the ladder name is unknown
142     */
143    public abstract int getLadderLosses(Player player, String ladder, WeightClass weightClass);
144
145    /**
146     * Get the player's global wins. Main thread only.
147     * @param player The player
148     * @return The player's global wins (unranked + ranked), or -1 if the player has no loaded profile
149     */
150    public abstract int getGlobalWins(Player player);
151
152    /**
153     * Retrieves the nametag information of a given player. Main thread only.
154     *
155     * @param player The player whose nametag information is to be retrieved.
156     * @return The {@link PlayerNametag} associated with the specified player, containing
157     *         prefix, name color, and suffix components, or null if the player has no loaded profile.
158     */
159    public abstract PlayerNametag getPlayerNametag(Player player);
160
161    /**
162     * Get the player's current state. Main thread only.
163     * @param player The player
164     * @return The player's state, never null; {@link PlayerState#UNKNOWN} if the player has no loaded profile
165     */
166    public abstract PlayerState getPlayerState(Player player);
167
168    /**
169     * Get the live match the player fights in. Spectated matches are not returned. Main thread only.
170     * @param player The player
171     * @return The match, or null if the player is not fighting in a match
172     */
173    public abstract Match getMatch(Player player);
174
175    /**
176     * Get the match the player is spectating. Main thread only.
177     * @param player The player
178     * @return The spectated match, or null if the player is not spectating a match
179     */
180    public abstract Match getSpectatingMatch(Player player);
181
182    /**
183     * Get a match by its id, including matches that already ended. Main thread only.
184     * @param matchId The match id, see {@link Match#getMatchId()}
185     * @return The match, or null if no match has this id
186     * @since 2.6.0
187     */
188    public abstract Match getMatchById(String matchId);
189
190    /**
191     * Get the FFA the player fights in. Main thread only.
192     * @param player The player
193     * @return The FFA, or null if the player is not fighting in an FFA
194     */
195    public abstract FFA getFfa(Player player);
196
197    /**
198     * Get the event the player is in. Main thread only.
199     * @param player The player
200     * @return The event, or null if the player is not in an event
201     */
202    public abstract dev.nandi0813.api.Interface.Event getEvent(Player player);
203
204    /**
205     * Get the party the player is in. Main thread only.
206     * @param player The player
207     * @return The party, or null if the player is not in a party
208     */
209    public abstract Party getParty(Player player);
210
211    /**
212     * Get the queue the player is in. Main thread only.
213     * @param player The player
214     * @return The queue, or null if the player is not queued
215     */
216    public abstract Queue getQueue(Player player);
217
218    /**
219     * Get the names of all enabled ladders. Main thread only.
220     * @return An unmodifiable list of ladder names, never null
221     */
222    public abstract List<String> getLadderNames();
223
224    /**
225     * Get the player's kills on a specific ladder. Main thread only.
226     * @param player The player
227     * @param ladder The ladder name
228     * @return The player's kills, or -1 if the player has no loaded profile or the ladder name is unknown
229     */
230    public abstract int getLadderKills(Player player, String ladder);
231
232    /**
233     * Get the player's deaths on a specific ladder. Main thread only.
234     * @param player The player
235     * @param ladder The ladder name
236     * @return The player's deaths, or -1 if the player has no loaded profile or the ladder name is unknown
237     */
238    public abstract int getLadderDeaths(Player player, String ladder);
239
240    /**
241     * Get the registry for addon cosmetics categories.
242     * @return The cosmetics registry, never null
243     */
244    public abstract CosmeticsRegistry getCosmeticsRegistry();
245
246    /**
247     * Get the registry for addon hotbar items.
248     * @return The hotbar item registry, never null
249     */
250    public abstract HotbarItemRegistry getHotbarItemRegistry();
251
252    /**
253     * Open the cosmetics hub for the player. Does nothing if the player has no loaded profile.
254     * Main thread only.
255     * @param player The player
256     */
257    public abstract void openCosmeticsMenu(Player player);
258
259    /**
260     * Get the registry for name decorators.
261     * @return The name decoration registry, never null
262     */
263    public abstract NameDecorationRegistry getNameDecorationRegistry();
264
265    /**
266     * Get the player's current global win streak. Main thread only.
267     * @param player The player
268     * @return The win streak, or -1 if the player has no loaded profile
269     */
270    public abstract int getWinStreak(Player player);
271
272    /**
273     * Get the player's best global win streak. Main thread only.
274     * @param player The player
275     * @return The best win streak, or -1 if the player has no loaded profile
276     */
277    public abstract int getBestWinStreak(Player player);
278
279    /**
280     * Get the player's best win streak on a specific ladder and weight class. Main thread only.
281     * @param player The player
282     * @param ladder The ladder name
283     * @param weightClass The weight class
284     * @return The best win streak, or -1 if the player has no loaded profile or the ladder name is unknown
285     */
286    public abstract int getLadderBestWinStreak(Player player, String ladder, WeightClass weightClass);
287
288    /**
289     * Get the player's current FFA kill streak. Main thread only.
290     * @param player The player
291     * @return The kill streak, or -1 if the player has no loaded profile
292     */
293    public abstract int getKillStreak(Player player);
294
295    /**
296     * Get the player's best global FFA kill streak. Main thread only.
297     * @param player The player
298     * @return The best kill streak, or -1 if the player has no loaded profile
299     */
300    public abstract int getBestKillStreak(Player player);
301
302    /**
303     * Get the player's best FFA kill streak on a specific ladder. Main thread only.
304     * @param player The player
305     * @param ladder The ladder name
306     * @return The best kill streak, or -1 if the player has no loaded profile or the ladder name is unknown
307     */
308    public abstract int getLadderBestKillStreak(Player player, String ladder);
309
310    /**
311     * Get the player's kills summed over all ladders. Main thread only.
312     * @param player The player
313     * @return The global kills, or -1 if the player has no loaded profile
314     */
315    public abstract int getGlobalKills(Player player);
316
317    /**
318     * Get the player's global matches played (wins + losses). Main thread only.
319     * @param player The player
320     * @return The matches played, or -1 if the player has no loaded profile
321     */
322    public abstract int getMatchesPlayed(Player player);
323
324    /**
325     * Get the time the player first joined the server. Main thread only.
326     * @param player The player
327     * @return The first join time in epoch millis, or -1 if the player has no loaded profile
328     */
329    public abstract long getFirstJoin(Player player);
330
331    /**
332     * Get the names of all divisions, ordered lowest to highest. Main thread only.
333     * @param divisionName Short or Full name of the divisions
334     * @return An unmodifiable list of division names, never null
335     */
336    public abstract List<String> getDivisionNames(DivisionName divisionName);
337
338    /**
339     * Get the player's position on a leaderboard. Main thread only.
340     * @param player The player
341     * @param type The statistic the leaderboard is ranked by
342     * @param ladder The ladder name, or null for the global leaderboard.
343     * @return The 1-based position, or -1 if the player is not on the leaderboard, the leaderboard does not exist,
344     *         or the ladder name is unknown. Leaderboards hold the top entries only and refresh periodically.
345     */
346    public abstract int getLeaderboardPosition(Player player, LeaderboardType type, String ladder);
347
348    /**
349     * Get the current top entries of a leaderboard. Main thread only.
350     * The returned list is a snapshot of the core's cached board, ordered by rank. It may refresh periodically.
351     * @param type The statistic the leaderboard is ranked by
352     * @param ladder The ladder name, or null for the global leaderboard
353     * @param limit The maximum number of entries, clamped to 1-100
354     * @return An unmodifiable list ordered by rank, never null. Empty if the leaderboard does not exist or has no entries.
355     * @since 2.9.0
356     */
357    public abstract List<LeaderboardEntry> getLeaderboardEntries(LeaderboardType type, String ladder, int limit);
358
359    /**
360     * Get the player's entry on a leaderboard, including the score. Main thread only.
361     * @param player The player
362     * @param type The statistic the leaderboard is ranked by
363     * @param ladder The ladder name, or null for the global leaderboard
364     * @return The player's entry, or null if the player is not on the leaderboard, the leaderboard does not exist,
365     *         or the ladder name is unknown. Leaderboards hold the top entries only and refresh periodically.
366     * @since 2.9.0
367     */
368    public abstract LeaderboardEntry getLeaderboardEntry(Player player, LeaderboardType type, String ladder);
369
370    /**
371     * Queue the player for a ladder, like the queue menu does. The player gets the usual queue messages.
372     * Already queued for the ladder: nothing changes. Main thread only.
373     * @param player The player
374     * @param ladder The ladder name
375     * @param ranked true for the ranked queue, false for unranked
376     * @param keepInventoryOpen Keep the player's open inventory open, only applies with multi-queue
377     * @return true if the player is queued for the ladder or a match started right away; false if the player has
378     *         no loaded profile, is not in the lobby or a queue, is in staff mode or a party, the ladder is unknown,
379     *         disabled, frozen or unranked-only for a ranked queue, or a queue requirement failed
380     * @since 2.7.0
381     */
382    public abstract boolean queuePlayer(Player player, String ladder, boolean ranked, boolean keepInventoryOpen);
383
384    /**
385     * Remove a ladder from the player's queue. The queue ends when it was the last ladder.
386     * Does nothing if the player is not queued for the ladder. Main thread only.
387     * @param player The player
388     * @param ladder The ladder name
389     * @since 2.7.0
390     */
391    public abstract void leaveQueue(Player player, String ladder);
392
393    /**
394     * End the player's queue for every ladder. Does nothing if the player is not queued. Main thread only.
395     * @param player The player
396     * @since 2.7.0
397     */
398    public abstract void leaveAllQueues(Player player);
399
400    /**
401     * Check whether the player may queue for several ladders at once. Main thread only.
402     * @param player The player
403     * @return true if multi-queue is enabled in the config and the player has its permission
404     * @since 2.7.0
405     */
406    public abstract boolean isMultiQueueAllowed(Player player);
407
408    /**
409     * Get the names of the ladders the player is queued for. Main thread only.
410     * @param player The player
411     * @return An unmodifiable list of ladder names, empty if the player is not queued, never null
412     * @since 2.7.0
413     */
414    public abstract List<String> getQueuedLadderNames(Player player);
415
416    /**
417     * Check whether the player is queued for a ladder. Main thread only.
418     * @param player The player
419     * @param ladder The ladder name
420     * @return true if the player is queued for the ladder
421     * @since 2.7.0
422     */
423    public abstract boolean isQueued(Player player, String ladder);
424
425    /**
426     * Get the number of players queued for a ladder in one queue type. Main thread only.
427     * @param ladder The ladder name
428     * @param ranked true for the ranked queue, false for unranked
429     * @return The number of queued players, or -1 if the ladder name is unknown
430     * @since 2.7.0
431     */
432    public abstract int getQueuePlayerCount(String ladder, boolean ranked);
433
434    /**
435     * Get the number of players queued for a ladder, ranked and unranked together. Main thread only.
436     * @param ladder The ladder name
437     * @return The number of queued players, or -1 if the ladder name is unknown
438     * @since 2.7.0
439     */
440    public abstract int getQueuePlayerCount(String ladder);
441
442    /**
443     * Get the icon of a ladder. Main thread only.
444     * @param ladder The ladder name
445     * @return A copy of the ladder icon, or null if the ladder name is unknown or the ladder has no icon
446     * @since 2.7.0
447     */
448    public abstract ItemStack getLadderIcon(String ladder);
449
450    /**
451     * Get the display name of a ladder. Main thread only.
452     * @param ladder The ladder name

454     * @since 2.7.0
455     */
456    public abstract String getLadderDisplayName(String ladder);
457
458    /**
459     * Get the player's progress towards the next division, the same value the division menu shows. Main thread only.

466

468     * Get the division after the player's current division. Main thread only.

475
476    /**

494    /**
495     * Get the global wins a division requires. Main thread only.
496     * @param division The division's key in divisions.yml, or its short or full name as returned by

503    /**
504     * Get the registry that connects a bot addon to ZonePractice Pro.
505     * @return The bot registry, never null
506     * @since 2.8.0
507     */
508    public abstract BotRegistry getBotRegistry();
509
510    /**
511     * Leases a free arena for an addon session, for example to show something to players in it.
512     * Build arenas and their copies are exclusive: no match or other lease starts in them until release.
513     * Other arenas are shared and stay open for matches. Main thread only.
514     * Leases are released automatically when the owner plugin disables.
515     * @param owner the addon plugin
516     * @param arenaName name of an arena (not a copy); its free copies are used too
517     * @return the lease, or null if the arena is unknown, disabled, frozen or has no free copy
518     * @since 2.11.0
519     */
520    public abstract ArenaLease leaseArena(Plugin owner, String arenaName);
521
522}
